lines.2: 「Everyone, homeroom is about to start, so sit down.」
lines.3: 「Come on. Class 2-C is still making noise too.」
lines.4: 「Don't use that idiot class as an example. When the bell rings, you sit down properly. That's only right.」
lines.6: 「All you have to do is sit down. It really gets on my nerves when people stray from the proper way of doing things.」
lines.7: 「Now, now. Ozawa, just take your seat.」
lines.9: 「Murata, you're the class representative. Keep everyone under control.」
lines.10: 「I know. I don't want us turning into an idiot class like 2-C.」
lines.11: 「But you don't have to get so emotional about it.」
lines.13: 「See? Nishizaki sitting next to you is saying the same thing.」
lines.14: 「I can't smile when I'm not having fun.」
